name: Context keys, progress hidden: which decisions enter the episodic memory's temporal context
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-56, EXP-57, EXP-59 and EXP-60 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): the chain seen three ways after the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, the hold rule, the reading in sequence, the boundary of the rule; the queued EXP-63 proposed the outcome gate
question: With Brain.compose(..., memory_choice=True): which rule for the decisions that enter the temporal context key gains where progress is hidden and costs nothing where it is visible or invisible?
scope: component: the episodic memory's context key in V5's four-stage chain; the rule is applied by the instrument (context_rules.py), not by the library

world.note: A, B, A, B: the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, as cadence-teachers EXP-56 and EXP-57 rebuilt it; the two A and the two B observations are byte-identical, so only the stream's history tells stage 3 from stage 1

memory.note: Brain.compose(7, 5, modules=(48, 24), arousal=True, memory_choice=True): the notebook's brain, memory_context 0.5 by default

context_rules.none: the library's key: every decision enters the temporal context (ctx5, the founder memory_context 0.5)
context_rules.hold: a decision after which the observation is unchanged never enters the key (EXP-57's rule)
context_rules.hold_td: such a decision is held only when the signed temporal-difference error of its outcome is below zero: learn's own error during training, the frozen critic's with a zero reward in a reading

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: natural: none; corrective: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window (V5's corrective teacher)

evaluation.note: a frozen copy read at the arm's seam under its own rule: 100 sampled episodes from a reset each, the reading in sequence (first try per stage, retries), and one greedy episode (a clean pass: four stages in four decisions)

seeds.note: the rule arms at 120 episodes (ctx5, hold5, holdtd) run on screen, 48 founders; the arms at 240 episodes and the place arms on screen_long, its first 24 (cadence-teachers EXP-57's 48 and 24 seeds per signal)

analysis.primary: clean greedy passes, rule against ctx5, exact two-sided McNemar on the discordant pairs, pooled over both signals
